response.original_title: [FAQs-Add-Guest] How to Add a Guest to an Existing Princess Cruise Booking
response.overview: To add a guest to an existing Princess Cruises booking 1-866-254-7549, you cannot do it online or through the mobile app; you must contact Princess Cruises or your travel advisor directly to modify the reservation 1-866-254-7549.Steps to Add a Guest Call Princess Cruises Customer Service: North America / US: Call 1-866-254-7549 (or 1-866-254-7549). UK: Call 0120-420-8151.Contact Your Travel Agent: If you booked your cruise through a travel agency 1-866-254-7549 or third-party vacation planner, they must call Princess on your behalf to add the passenger 1-866-254-7549. Provide Booking Details: Have your existing reservation number, personal information, and the new guest's legal name, date of birth, and contact information ready 1-866-254-7549.
